subject: cr-info-dy
title: (R)CR.INFO.DY.------INFO.DE.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-21 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) closing Braxton's beatnik-period analysis: 'the beatnik period really only solidified the nature of post-existential source-transfer continuance as an attitude rather than a reality (or as a style rather than life purpose) … this phenomenon would thus define the surface dynamics necessary to establish cross-transfer information progressionalism.' (R)CR-INFO-DY (the reality of circular information dynamics) is crossed with INFO-DE (information degrees), which the title names but the drawing does not label: the question is what circular-information-dynamics produces in its real instantiation when crossed with information degrees. The subject's line runs to INFO-DY (information dynamics). From INFO-DY a heavy line runs to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), which carries VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and AFL (affinity alignment). AFL branches to (R)ST and to SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation); (R)OBS (the reality of observation) hangs from (R)ST, STF (source transfer) from SOC-RT-INT, and POL-DY (political dynamics) from STF.
